name: Porcelain Keynote
tagline: motion-video-workflow's porcelain shell: cool white, one blue, highlighter yellow, stamps that land 1.9 → 1 in 0.24 s.

motion.direction: motion-video-workflow porcelain keynote. A cool white keynote: Inter 900 titles (74 px, slight skew), a `stamp` that lands 1.9 → 1 in 0.24 s with 7° → 0 rotation, a highlighter bar in yellow `gold` under the key word, `counter`s with 128 px tabular numbers (1.6 → 1 in 0.24 s), `chips` as pills, a 6 px progress line. Camera-continuous transitions (whip 0.22 s with blur) 3–4 per minute; key info holds ≥ 0.9–1.2 s; one message per frame, keywords become picture elements — never whole sentences. One blue `ter`, cyan `goldd` as the second accent.
